title: Sales Manager DSA
description:
Hiring: DSA Sales Manager – Home Loans

Location: kottayam , Kerala

Department : Sales – Home Loans

Experience : Minimum 2 years in team handling

Industry : Banking / Housing Finance / NBFC

Job Description

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented DSA Sales Manager – Home Loans to lead and manage the sales team in kottayam. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in home loan sales, DSA channel development, team management, and customer acquisition.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, manage, and motivate a team of DSA sales executives to achieve home loan business targets.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with DSA partners, builders, real estate agents, connectors, and other referral sources.
* Generate quality home loan leads and drive business growth through the DSA channel.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand the DSA network across calicut and surrounding areas.
* Monitor team performance, sales productivity, lead conversion, and monthly disbursement targets.
* Coordinate with credit, operations, legal, and technical teams to ensure smooth loan processing and timely disbursement.
* Ensure proper documentation, customer service, and compliance with company policies.
* Conduct regular team meetings, sales reviews, and market visits to improve productivity.
* Prepare sales reports, track the sales pipeline, and implement strategies to achieve business goals.

Eligibility Criteria

* Minimum 2 years of team handling experience in sales.
* Experience in home loans, LAP, housing finance, banking.
* Strong understanding of DSA sales, lead generation, and loan sourcing.
* Proven ability to manage sales teams and achieve business targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Must be willing to work in the kottayam location.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and suitability.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to grow in the banking and housing finance industry.
* A target-driven and professional work environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume through direct message or email, mentioning “DSA Sales Manager – kottayam” in the subject line.

Join us and take the next step in your career in home loan sales and team leadership!

title: Team Leader / Sale Manager-Personal Loan
